% pgfplots figure for Chapter 5: reads figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat, which is
% generated by code/figures/gen_ch05_replanning.py.  Event 0 is the initial search.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[name=left,width=0.5\textwidth,height=5.8cm,xlabel={event (obstacle number)},
  ylabel={vertex expansions},ymode=log,log ticks with fixed point,grid=major,font=\footnotesize,
  xmin=0,xmax=40,ymin=0.7,ymax=4000,
  legend columns=3,legend style={at={(1.16,-0.34)},anchor=north,font=\footnotesize,
  /tikz/every even column/.append style={column sep=0.35cm}}]
\addplot[black!50,thick,densely dotted,mark=none] table[x=event,y=astarg_exp]{figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat};
\addlegendentry{\astar from scratch, ties toward smaller $\gcost$}
\addplot[sbOrange,thick,mark=square*,mark size=1.2pt] table[x=event,y=astar_exp]{figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat};
\addlegendentry{\astar from scratch, ties toward smaller $\hcost$}
\addplot[sbBlue,thick,mark=*,mark size=1.2pt] table[x=event,y=dsl_exp]{figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat};
\addlegendentry{\dstarlite repair}
\end{axis}
\begin{axis}[name=right,at={(left.east)},anchor=west,xshift=1.6cm,width=0.5\textwidth,height=5.8cm,
  xlabel={event (obstacle number)},ylabel={time per event [ms]},ymode=log,log ticks with fixed point,
  grid=major,font=\footnotesize,xmin=0,xmax=40]
\addplot[black!50,thick,densely dotted,mark=none] table[x=event,y=astarg_ms]{figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat};
\addplot[sbOrange,thick,mark=square*,mark size=1.2pt] table[x=event,y=astar_ms]{figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat};
\addplot[sbBlue,thick,mark=*,mark size=1.2pt] table[x=event,y=dsl_ms]{figures/data/ch05-replanning.dat};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
